title: Personal Services Plan — Requests to Suspend a Package for the Longest Allowed Period
content:
A resident of the Personal Services Plan who asks to suspend the package for as long as the package allows is suspended for whole calendar months. The signed suspension records the first suspended month and the number of months it runs, and the suspension ends on the last day of its last suspended month. The Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan has nothing to suspend.

## When the number of months is fixed

The number of months a suspension may run is fixed only after every hourly charge on the plan that its visit record shows billed on more time than was delivered carries a service dispute credit referencing it.

Put another way: while any hourly charge on the plan whose visit record shows more time billed than was delivered is without a service dispute credit referencing it, the number of months a suspension may run is not yet fixed.

## What the signed suspension shows

| Recorded on the plan | Value |
|---|---|
| Suspension start | The first day of the first suspended month |
| Suspension end | The last day of the last suspended month |
| Months | The whole calendar months suspended, counted from and including the first suspended month |

During the suspended months no package fee is charged and no hours are granted. Signing does not itself change the plan's status; the suspension takes hold on its start date.

## Invocation: `sign_services_suspension_89d6021d`

**Capability.** The tool records a signed suspension of a personal services plan for a run of whole calendar months: the suspension start becomes the first day of the first suspended month and the suspension end the last day of the last suspended month, so that no package fee is charged and no hours are granted for those months.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_services_suspension_89d6021d` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the resident or the resident's financial agent — runs it to sign the suspension.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `services_plan_id` | Reference number of the personal services plan being suspended, as returned by the personal services plan lookup for this resident | Identifier |
| `first_suspended_month` | The first day of the first calendar month to be suspended, local community date | `YYYY-MM-DD` with the day always 01; never empty |
| `suspended_months` | The number of whole calendar months suspended, counted from and including the first suspended month | A positive integer, no fraction and no unit text |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `status` set to `suspension_signed` when the suspension is on record, `services_plan_id` (the plan reference number), `suspension_start_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, first day of the first suspended month), `suspension_end_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, last day of the last suspended month) and `suspended_months` (the integer number of months recorded).

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* `first_suspended_month` of `2026-11-01` with `suspended_months` of 3 is returned with a suspension start of `2026-11-01` and a suspension end of `2027-01-31`.
